reviewItem.question: Does "Allow the Go runtime to dynamically set `GOMAXPROCS` by @stefanprodan in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5501" mean a change to env-var:flux|name=GOMAXPROCS (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: Flux 2.7.0 now allows the Go runtime to dynamically set GOMAXPROCS (listed in the release notes' CLI changelog), so the way the effective GOMAXPROCS value of the affected Flux binary is determined changes; the note describes no failure or required action.
